title: /harness/reports
responsibility: Redirects the former report hub address to the explorer; the console has no report hub.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: The exported server load handler for /harness/reports. On every invocation it redirects to /harness and does not return report data.

errors.name: Redirect 308
